name: @hl-bos/visual-review
description: Browser-based visual website review: a real Chromium renders the homepage and the most relevant pages it links to, captures desktop and mobile screenshots, reads navigation, calls to action, forms and booking/registration paths, and records exactly what could and could not be seen. Read-only by construction: every non-GET request is refused, nothing is clicked except menu toggles, no form is ever submitted, security blocks and CAPTCHAs are recorded and never worked around.
